ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of child care fraud in Minnesota and explore the potential for similar issues in other states.
questions: How widespread is child care fraud?
What measures can be taken to prevent it?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a significant issue in the child care system and could lead to changes in how federal funding is allocated and monitored.
